units.title: SG-1.4.2 · Render HeaderOverlay from App through the GameLayout header slot
Act: Add header slot prop to GameLayout
Act: Wire round loading/error state and HeaderOverlay into App
Act: Remove RoundBadge and Countdown usage from App
Verify: GameLayout header slot unit tests

tests.name: header inside main
tests.title: GameLayout renders the header slot inside main, not inside the aside
tests.scenario: Given GameLayout with a header, a scene and a story, when rendered, then the header renders inside main and not inside the aside
tests.detail: Header test id is a descendant of main and not of aside.

tests.name: omitted header leaves layout unchanged
tests.title: GameLayout without a header still renders scene and story and no header node
tests.scenario: Given GameLayout without a header, when rendered, then scene and story nodes are present and no header node exists
tests.detail: scene-node and story-node present; queryByTestId('hdr') is null.

units.title: Verify: App header round states unit tests

tests.name: appHeader.test.tsx > App header round states > loading state
tests.title: shows the loading message in the header while the round request is pending
tests.scenario: Given the round request is pending, when the player begins, then the header shows 'Loading round…'

tests.name: appHeader.test.tsx > App header round states > success state
tests.title: shows the round id and status in the header once the round loads
tests.scenario: Given the round loads, when the player begins, then the header shows the round id and status

tests.name: appHeader.test.tsx > App header round states > error state
tests.title: shows an alert containing the error message when the round request fails
tests.scenario: Given the round request fails, when the player begins, then the header shows an alert with the error message

units.title: Verify: No standalone RoundBadge or Countdown in App unit tests

tests.id: appNoLegacyHeader.test.tsx::App legacy header removal > Given the round is loaded, then exactly one timer renders inside the header banner
tests.name: App legacy header removal > Given the round is loaded, then exactly one timer renders inside the header banner
tests.title: Given the round is loaded, then exactly one timer renders inside the header banner
tests.scenario: Given App is rendered and Begin is clicked with getCurrentRound mocked to roundFixture; When the round id appears; Then getAllByRole('timer') has length 1 and that timer is contained in the banner
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appNoLegacyHeader.test.tsx

tests.id: appNoLegacyHeader.test.tsx::App legacy header removal > Given App.tsx source, then it has no RoundBadge or Countdown references
tests.name: App legacy header removal > Given App.tsx source, then it has no RoundBadge or Countdown references
tests.title: Given App.tsx source, then it has no RoundBadge or Countdown references
tests.scenario: Given the App.tsx source file on disk; When it is read; Then it does not match /RoundBadge|Countdown/
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appNoLegacyHeader.test.tsx
